cases.objective: Verify that tapping 'Reload Now' triggers an immediate app reload/update
cases.precondition: User is logged in on the Home screen and the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Bottom sheet shows title 'Update Ready', description text, 'Reload Now' button, and 'Maybe Later' link
steps.step: Observe the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet displayed over the Home screen

steps.expected_result: App begins reloading/updating immediately and relaunches with the new version applied

cases.title: Tap Reload Now to update the app immediately

cases.objective: Verify that tapping 'Maybe Later' dismisses the update sheet and defers the update to next app open
cases.precondition: User is logged in on the Home screen and the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Bottom sheet shows 'Reload Now' button and 'Maybe Later' link
steps.step: Observe the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet displayed over the Home screen

steps.expected_result: Bottom sheet is dismissed and the user is returned to the fully interactive Home screen without any update being applied immediately

cases.title: Tap Maybe Later to defer the update
